provenance.title: ALGORITHMS FOR HIGHLY SYMMETRIC LINEAR AND INTEGER PROGRAMS
provenance.authors: RICHARD BÖDI, KATRIN HERR, AND MICHAEL JOSWIG

disposition: proposals only — promote via document-intake Stage 4; nothing here is folio content and nothing here creates Lean

candidates.statement: [\[cor:opt_sol_in_fix\]](#cor:opt_sol_in_fix){reference-type="ref" reference="cor:opt_sol_in_fix"} and Theorem [\[thm:barycenter_ineqs\]](#thm:barycenter_ineqs){reference-type="ref" reference="thm:barycenter_ineqs"} yield a direct algorithm for solving a symmetric linear program: instead of solving $\operatorname{LP}(A,b,c)$ one can solve the linear program [\[eq:reduced_LP\]](#eq:reduced_LP){reference-type="eqref" reference="eq:reduced_LP"}. The benefit is the following: The larger the group $\Gamma\leq\operatorname{Aut}(\operatorname{LP}(A,b,c))$ the smaller the dimension of the fixed space
